builds.name: Reference: Physical spell burst
builds.goal: Reference for Pantheon: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A melee pick fighter who stages empowered abilities, stuns a target and blocks directional retaliation. He seeks decisive ability windows with attacks preparing the next empowerment. Fix Mortal Will and empowered W attack sequence. Check current on-hit effectiveness and crit compatibility; empowered E defense is a timed window, not permanent immunity. High AD and penetration test ability-first trades with a conditional anti-magic slot.
builds.summary: High AD and penetration test ability-first trades with a conditional anti-magic slot.
testPlan: Kit question for Pantheon: Fix Mortal Will and empowered W attack sequence. Check current on-hit effectiveness and crit compatibility; empowered E defense is a timed window, not permanent immunity.

Start with the early core (Eclipse, then Profane Hydra) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: High AD and penetration test ability-first trades with a conditional anti-magic slot. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Maw is matchup-specific; this does not inherit a full tank build's survival.

The route fails Pantheon's stated kit question: Fix Mortal Will and empowered W attack sequence. Check current on-hit effectiveness and crit compatibility; empowered E defense is a timed window, not permanent immunity.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Maw is matchup-specific; this does not inherit a full tank build's survival.
Full cost 15,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Eclipse, then Profane Hydra. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night, Maw of Malmortius are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula: After using [5] Abilities or Attacks, Pantheon empowers his next basic Ability.

Pantheon leaps on his target, Stunning for [1] second and dealing [0.06 / 0.065 / 0.07 / 0.075 / 0.08 + (4e-05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (0.00015) × AP] max Health physical damage.

Mortal Will Bonus: Pantheon's next Attack strikes [3] times, dealing a total of [((characterLevelInterpolation(0.4 → 0.55; raw flags preserved)) × AD) × (3)] physical damage.

Tap: Pantheon thrusts his spear, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (1.15) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to enemies hit. Refunds [60]% of this Ability's Cooldown.

Hold: Pantheon hurls his spear, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (1.15) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.5) × AP] physical damage to the first enemy hit and [50]% less to further targets. 

This Ability is enhanced against enemies below [20]% Health to deal [(70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + 85 / 130 / 175 / 220 / 265) + (2.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage instead.

Mortal Will Bonus: Deals an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 240; raw flags preserved) + (1.15) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Pantheon braces his shield and engages enemies in a chosen direction for [1.5] seconds, becoming immune to non-tower damage from that direction and dealing [(1) × AD] physical damage over the duration. After channeling Pantheon slams with his shield, dealing [55 / 105 / 155 / 205 / 255 + (1.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Mortal Will Bonus: When Pantheon slams his shield he gains [characterLevelInterpolation(5 → 30; raw flags preserved) + (0.025) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Armor and [characterLevelInterpolation(5 → 30; raw flags preserved) + (0.025) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Magic Resist for [4] seconds, and [60]% Move Speed for [1.5] seconds.

Passive: Pantheon gains [(0.1 / 0.2 / 0.3) × 100]% Armor Penetration.

Active: Pantheon gathers his strength to leap high into the air. He throws his spear from above which in a small area deals @spell.PantheonQ:HoldDamageCalc@ physical damage and Slows by [50]% for [2] seconds. 

Pantheon then crashes down as a meteor at the target area. Deals up to [300 / 500 / 700 + (1) × AP] magic damage to enemies in a line (decreased by up to [50]% at the edges of the area).

This Ability instantly readies Mortal Will.

builds.name: Empowered vault on-hit
builds.summary: Test empowered vault on-hit against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test empowered vault on-hit against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Mortal Will's Shield Vault empowers the next attack to strike three times; Blade and Terminus test physical/magic item pressure in that contact window. Trinity supplies one independent physical Spellblade after W, while E provides directional protection after the triple hit. Death's Dance replaces the incompatible Cleaver slot to protect the attack window.
testPlan: Required state: Prepare five passive stacks before W and attack immediately.
Measure each empowered attack packet and PTA proc against an unempowered W.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Peel between W and the attack or low spell AD loses the burst.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Three strikes do not imply three Spellblade activations or full unrestricted on-hit effectiveness.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Trinity Force, Terminus, Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.goal: Test health empowered shield bruiser against conventional damage at equal gold.

Bloodmail converts purchased health to AD for Q/E, while Sundered Sky rewards one owner attack and Visage its heal.
testPlan: Required state: Use empowered E after the damage trade and preserve correct shield facing.
Measure post-E resistances and W damage at matched AD and different health.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Rear damage bypasses E and fewer offensive items miss Q's execute window.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.

Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
